newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Belgian soccer fan injured in clash in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Belgian soccer fan injured in clash in Portugal.

text.p: A Belgian fan was in hospital on Wednesday with suspected head injuries after police and Anderlecht supporters clashed during an UEFA Cup soccer match with Victoria Guimaraes on Tuesday night, hospital officials said.

Police moved in after around 150 fans of the Belgian club, who had travelled to Guimaraes in northern Portugal for the game, tried to break down a barrier separating them from Guimaraes supporters, a police spokesman said.
Two other Belgians were treated in hospital for cuts and bruises but were able to return to Belgium with the rest of the Anderlecht supporters, police said.
A third supporter, identified by hospital officials as David Diseur, was under observation in hospital in nearby Braga because of the suspected head injuries.
The first leg, second round match match ended 1-1.
